shell

layout · 0.1.1 · A2 · aj-l-shell

The product shell (.app): the unruled paper ground every screen sits on, the container every responsive rule queries, and the positioning context for the rail. It holds the rail, the page and, at desktop, the title block.

Auth surface

The plain-paper sign-in spread: full window height, set in --rule (13-login).

Account surface

The signed-out screens without the spread (16-flow-states, 17-account-data): drawn as the notebook; modules read data-surface="account" as a context.

Journal

Motion scope

The product shell (data-motion="arrive"): arrival motion runs only inside it, never in the guide or the catalogue. Modules read it as a context.

Journal

Sidebar

The desktop shell with a title block as its first column. Its grid follows the layout (v4 D1: pages ask for sidebar only from 1200), so it reads as two columns here too (02-timeline).
